verdict.rationale: smolagents lets users give natural-language task strings to agent.run(...) which the agent interprets and executes via code/tool calls, and ships CLI utilities (smolagent, webagent) for quick natural-language-driven runs without boilerplate. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of a conversational or chat-style NL interface beyond the single-shot run() call, and no evidence of multi-turn NL dialogue support.
